title: Buttermilk Vanilla Waffles
changes_from_base: Egg whites only and buttermilk instead of milk, sweetened with icing sugar and flavoured with vanilla pod seeds and vanilla; the whites go straight into the batter, not whisked, and there is no fruit or cream.
summary: Light buttermilk waffles flecked with real vanilla seeds, cooked until golden and best served dripping with maple syrup.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
vanilla pod, split and seeds scraped

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix 185 g plain flour, 45 g icing sugar, ¼ tsp salt, ½ tsp bicarbonate of soda, ½ tsp baking powder and the scraped seeds of 1 vanilla pod in a bowl until the seeds are evenly spread.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Add 395 ml buttermilk, 40 g melted butter, 2 egg whites and 1 tsp vanilla and whisk until smooth.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the waffle iron on medium until ready.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Pour in about a third of the batter for an 18 cm Belgian iron, or half for a 20 cm square iron, close the lid and cook until golden brown but still steaming, 4½-6 min depending on the iron.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve at once with plenty of maple syrup, then cook the remaining batter the same way.

tips: Scrape the vanilla pod seeds into the dry ingredients first so they spread evenly rather than clumping in the wet batter.
Cooking times vary between irons, so judge doneness by a waffle that's golden yet still steaming rather than by time alone.
Serve each waffle as soon as it's cooked, since they're best enjoyed hot with the maple syrup rather than kept waiting.
storage: Best eaten fresh and warm, straight from the iron. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
